metadata.description: PAM V1 retrieval evaluation dataset v2.0. 160 queries (124 positive, 36 negative) against 12 documents. Expanded in Phase 3D from original v1.0 (50 queries).

categories.factoid: Single-fact questions answerable from one document
categories.comparison: Questions requiring information from multiple documents
categories.negative: Questions with no answer in the corpus
categories.tricky: Questions where the answer is partial or requires careful reading
